title: meta@1: a standard language
description: languages/<id>/meta.json. Which content a language has is not listed here: generators find it from the files in the folder. Its regional varieties and historical stages live in varieties/<id>/meta.json (variety@1).

id.description: Unique across every language and variety. Must match the folder name.

nativeName.description: The name in the language itself.

code.description: ISO 639-3 code (three lowercase letters) or Glottolog code (four letters and four digits).

scripts.description: Writing systems, in the order the learner shows them.

characterKeys.description: Character Learner script keys. Empty when the language has no Character Learner script.

romanization.description: Romanization systems used, main one first (for example jyutping, pinyin, hepburn).

speech.description: BCP 47 tag for text to speech.

font.description: A special font the language needs, such as pIqaD.

markers.description: Where grammar markers written as separate words (particles, prepositions, postpositions, articles, measure words) sit relative to the word they mark: "before" it (English to school, the bus) or "after" it (Japanese 学校に). "default" covers every marker; a grammar meaning id from meaning/meanings.jsonl ("@possessive") overrides it for that marker. Hyphenated affixes in the meaning matrix already show their side and don't need this. Used by squirrelator to group words into phrases.

varieties.description: Ids of the varieties in varieties/, alphabetical. Must match the folders there.
